name: portfolio-astro
title: Portfolio with Astro
description: Astro's official portfolio: a personal page, projects in Markdown and a work section, fast and easy to customize.
instructions:
## How to work here

- Each project is a `.md` file in `src/content/work/`; the home page and other pages are in `src/pages/`.
- Keep the design consistent by reusing the components in `src/components/`.
- Before finishing: `npm run build`.
